name: Process Hijacking or Persistence via IFEO Injection
description: Detects the creation of a key under Image File Execution Options (IFEO) and the setting of a 'Debugger' value. This technique is used for persistence or to hijack the execution of a legitimate process.

action.description: A process created or modified a key within Image File Execution Options (IFEO), potentially to set a debugger for process hijacking.

operational_usage: Investigate which process key was created (e.g., 'notepad.exe') and what value was set for the 'Debugger' parameter. This is a strong indicator of a sophisticated persistence or hijacking technique.
false_positive: Very rare. Some legitimate debugging tools (Visual Studio, WinDbg) or application compatibility shims may use this feature. Any other process modifying these keys is suspicious.
